data.name: Terrible Leap
data.description: When a rageshaper is in his devastating form, he can perform a terrible leap as a move action without attempting an Acrobatics check, jumping any distance up to his move speed (upward movement counts as double, as when flying). He can leap in this way %1 times per day.|ShifterLVL
